source_context: Bulk sandbox historical replay evidence pilot v0.2. Synthetic seed evidence for attribution-learning pipeline testing; not production evidence.
evidence_items: Singapore Manufacturing Operations output in 2021 was affected by maintenance shutdown, plant shutdown, and production disruption.
Supply disruption, factory closure, covid restrictions, and supply constraints affected production.
Operational disruption rather than demand alone shaped output movements.
Plant-level constraints and supply conditions affected manufacturing performance.
